notes.title: v2 Update: New Bus Station, NPCs & Visual Enhancements
notes.content:
A brand new v2 update has been released for Bus Simulator: Car Driving! Many important improvements and innovations have been added to the game in line with player feedback. Driving sensation, mission variety and technical quality are now at a much higher level.

Here are the innovations that come with the v2 update

 New Bus Stop added: Passenger pick-up and drop-off experience is now more diverse and realistic.
 New NPC characters added to the game: The city is now more lively. Passengers and city details have been increased and the atmosphere has been strengthened.
 Game optimized, graphics improved: Optimizations have been made for smoother performance on both low and high systems. Visual quality has been increased.
 How to Play section added: Help panel explaining controls and basic systems has been added for new players.
 Translation errors fixed: Translation and spelling errors encountered in the current 20+ language support in the game have been corrected.
 General errors fixed: Mission transitions, button functions and various minor in-game errors have been fixed.
 Camera system improved: In-car and out-of-car camera transitions have been made smoother. The sense of control while driving has been improved.
